china-1916:p0066_1.rationale: Textual list of principal Chinese products and their regions of origin, spanning crops, silk, tea, timber, coal and other goods; no quantities. No aggregate tag fits a mixed product-origin list.
review_questions: Propose an aggregate tag for product-origin lists.

china-1916:p0067_1.rationale: Province-by-province list of export products with export ports and routes; textual with no quantities.
review_questions: Propose an aggregate tag for mixed commodity-origin lists.

china-1916:p0074_1.rationale: Percentage shares of the world raw silk trade by country, 1909-1914.

china-1916:p0074_2.rationale: Silk export categories by share of total value and chief ports of original export, 1912.

china-1916:p0075_1.rationale: Annual value of silk exports from China in taels and pounds, 1910-1914.

china-1916:p0076_1.rationale: Export quantities and values of beans, beancake and bean oil, 1911-1914; the soybean connection is substantive.

china-1916:p0081_1.rationale: Yarn deliveries in Shanghai by origin (Shanghai, Japanese, Indian), 1913-1914; yarn is a textile product.

china-1916:p0082_2.rationale: Tobacco exports from Customs districts in pounds, 1910-1914.

china-1916:p0082_3.rationale: Tonnage of abutilon, hemp, jute and ramie moving through the Customs, 1909-1914; plant fibres is the aggregate tag.
review_questions: Direction of movement (imports vs exports) is not stated, so no import or export tag is assigned.
